why.T-24-06: escalated — out-of-scope: the only correct fix for the CI failure is one line in tests/smoke/docs-smoke.sh:189 (const MECHANICAL = new Set(['undraft','merge']) needs 'base-merge'), and that file is NOT in 24-06-PLAN.md's files_modified (the plan declared tests/smoke/sentinel-smoke.sh only). The ticket's code is correct and its own suites are green (sentinel 77/0, front 96/0, reviewers 11/0, log-event 11/0, sentinel-smoke 51/0); the docs contract has simply never heard of the base-merge duty. Every in-scope alternative was weighed and is wrong: removing base-merge from ACTIONABLE makes a dead-base PR vanish from all four duty buckets and report the guard 'clear' (the exact hole ADR-002 D4 closes); folding it into the merge action cannot reach the case, because a BEHIND base blocks a PR while it is still draft and in CI, long before merge-eligibility, and duty deliberately places base-merge ahead of threads and pending CI; renaming it to ci-fix breaks the plan's acceptance criterion, D4's naming, and spends the ticket's repair budget on a mechanical merge (which is why log-event.cjs gained base_merge as a NON-attempt event). Needs a human decision: either widen 24-06's files_modified to include tests/smoke/docs-smoke.sh, or add a third docs-smoke category for duty actions that dispatch under a declared role alias (base-merge is a hybrid: base-merge.cjs does the work, but fix-round.mjs needsBaseMerge can dispatch a fixer for an in-scope conflict, resolving at the ci-fix tier).. It lifts by itself once the PR moves (a push, a review answer, undrafting); `escalation-record.cjs clear T-24-06` to take it back.
